name: Sticking Sap
body:
Weapons that strike you are likely to get stuck.

Prerequisites: Plant Type, Oozing Sap

Benefit: A weapon that strikes you becomes stuck fast to sticky sap unless the wielder succeeds at a DC 15 Reflex save. A stuck weapon can be pried free with a DC 15 Strength check, but doing so provokes an attack of opportunity from the creature it is stuck to.
